name: How long does it take to repair a hidden water leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a hidden water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to repair a hidden water leak depends on its location and severity. Simple repairs might take a few hours once the leak is identified. More complex issues, such as slab leaks or those requiring access through walls or floors, could take a day or more, especially if structural repairs are also needed. A professional plumber can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing the specific leak.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours to over a day, depending on the leak's location and complexity.
